conditional_on: Only consider after R54 finishes and is not qualified; do not interrupt or run alongside R54.
mechanism: A separately randomized boosted-tree family: shallow LightGBM with one random split threshold per feature. Earlier W3 ExtraTreesClassifier was an unboosted forest; R41 changed only feature sampling in ordinary boosting. Neither is this published randomized boosting configuration.
source_caveat: Their outer-fold early stopping is optimistic, and their reported best score includes external public48-member predictions. We import neither code nor predictions. Published parameters motivate one own test, not a transferable performance claim.
prospective_training: Same validated84 inputs, context/source generators unchanged. One proper nested80/20 split per outer fold, inner-only map fits and AUC earlystop200/max12000; refit fresh full outer training at selected iteration. No grid or outer-label round selection.
prospective_blend: Fixed .875logit(actualv11)+.125logit(newrandomizedLGB84), clipping1e-6. Same paired95% lower and corrected resampled-t lower>0, all5 before quality and onlythen fresh3. No weight/seed/feature rescue.
resources: CPU6, RSS8GiB, availableRAM2GiB, serial fits; no extra GPU use.
